methodChange: The output schema now fixes the exact top-level keys and array-valued applicability dimensions after v3 omitted schemaVersion and used an ambiguous dimension representation.

frozenFacts.use: Its embedded source facts are the frozen controller-supplied project contract; the unavailable external originals were not reread.

authorityContract.scope: Derive an implementation-independent Design-to-Visual acceptance contract from the approved image and frozen facts. This does not independently prove the external source files, current package, runtime, interaction, or user acceptance.

requiredOutput.applicabilityRule: Include only dimensions required by the check. Every dimension value is a non-empty array of exact authority names. Section placement never supplies applicability.
requiredOutput.semanticsRule: Use acceptance for product requirements and boundary for evidence limitations. Every check is atomic to one evidence layer; split cross-layer expectations and use stable unique ids.
requiredOutput.contentRule: Every check cites sourceIds and one observableFact. Do not include candidate coordinates or predicted verdicts. Preserve unavailable-source and unverified-layer limits without turning them into acceptance requirements.
